answer: One concrete defense is a per-key liveness chain. Each identity must keep a lantern of signed heartbeats, where every pulse commits to the previous hash plus a public epoch nonce, so work cannot be copied across keys. Peers only credit a vote or grade if that signal is current. Spawning an ocean of sockpuppets is cheap at signup, yet each clone needs its own unbroken, real-time chain or its bond is slashed and its weight drops to zero.
